title: Unit 33 Consolidation: The Literary Canon in Schools and Public Life, 2012–2026
grammar: Review: attribution, comparison, participles, contrast within a sentence and open questions
goal: I can summarise the main episodes of the debate about the literary canon between 2012 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can attribute judgements, compare with an earlier state, describe with participles, set facts side by side and state open questions.
I can give the Nobel Prize of 2025 and the election results of 2026 with dates.
